📰 Why does Luxor’s $16M funding round stand out amid the convergence of AI and Bitcoin mining?

Crypto hardware provider Luxor announced that it raised $160,000 from CMT Digital. The funds will be used to scale its AI infrastructure business and expand its GPU procurement services, as global chip supply chain pressures intensify. For Luxor, this is both a matter of survival and a barometer of industry trends.

Why does this news matter?
Behind Luxor’s funding round is the combined pressure of expanding AI applications and demand from the crypto mining industry. On one hand, AI development requires enormous computing power, and GPU shortages highlight the value of companies like Luxor that can provide solutions. On the other hand, declining profitability in Bitcoin mining is leading miners to favor more cost-effective GPUs. Luxor’s business model essentially builds a bridge between these two sources of demand. This coincides with tightening global chip supply chains, meaning that it’s not just miners competing for GPUs—AI companies are also stockpiling them at a rapid pace. This reflects a structural shift in demand for computing power, rather than a simple supply-and-demand imbalance.

Market impact
Although Luxor’s funding represents only a tiny fraction of the overall AI or mining market, its business model reflects two important industry trends: first, AI applications are becoming increasingly dependent on computing power; second, the mining industry is undergoing a technology-driven supply chain transformation. The news itself is likely to have minimal impact on BTC and ETH prices, but it signals fiercer competition on the demand side for computing power. This could indirectly drive up GPU prices and, in turn, affect the marginal cost of mining. If demand for GPUs from AI surges in the future, some computing power that would otherwise have been used for mining could be diverted, potentially challenging the long-term value proposition of Proof-of-Work chains such as BTC.

Trading considerations
The figures suggest that Luxor’s funding is not large enough to have a significant impact on BTC or ETH. The significance of the news lies in how it reveals shifts in the industry’s underlying dynamics. If demand for computing power from AI continues to accelerate, it could have a far-reaching impact on the computing power ecosystem across the crypto industry. This means it’s worth monitoring developments in areas such as computing power rentals and chip supply, rather than focusing solely on BTC or ETH price movements.

📰 为什么 Luxor 16M 美元融资在 AI 与比特币挖矿融合浪潮中显得如此特别？

加密货币硬件商 Luxor 宣布从 CMT Digital 筹集了 16 万美元资金，这笔钱将用于扩大其 AI 基础设施业务规模，并增加 GPU 采购服务，而全球芯片供应链的紧张局势正在加剧。对 Luxor 来说，这既是生存需求，也是行业风向标。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Luxor 的融资事件背后，是 AI 应用场景拓展与加密挖矿行业需求的双重挤压。一方面，AI 发展需要大量算力，GPU 供应短缺让 Luxor 这种能提供解决方案的企业价值凸显；另一方面，比特币挖矿的盈利能力下滑，使得矿工更倾向于选择性价比更高的 GPU。Luxor 的业务模式，本质上是在这两大需求间搭建桥梁。这与当前全球芯片供应链的紧张关系形成共振，意味着不仅矿工在抢 GPU，AI 领域也在疯狂囤货。这背后是算力需求的结构性变化，而非简单的供需失衡。

对市场的影响
虽然 Luxor 的融资额仅占整个 AI 或挖矿市场的冰山一角，但它的业务模式却反映了两个行业的重要趋势：一是 AI 应用对算力的依赖持续增强，二是挖矿行业正在经历技术驱动下的供应链重塑。对于 BTC 和 ETH 价格而言，这条新闻本身的影响微乎其微，但意味着算力需求端的竞争将更加激烈，可能会间接推高 GPU 价格，进而影响挖矿的边际成本。如果未来 AI 对 GPU 的需求爆发式增长，可能会分流一部分原本用于挖矿的算力，这对以 Proof-of-Work 为主的链（如 BTC）的长期价值主张构成潜在挑战。

操作思路
从数据上看，Luxor 的融资规模不足以对 BTC 或 ETH 产生显著影响，但这条新闻的意义在于揭示行业底层逻辑的演变。如果未来 AI 对算力的需求持续加速，可能会对整个加密货币行业的算力生态产生深远影响。这意味着需要关注算力租赁、芯片供应等领域的动态，而非仅仅盯着 BTC 或 ETH 的价格波动。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Market Sentiment Cycle: A Six-Act Play from Doubt to Euphoria
translatedData.subTitle:
The script of each market cycle is almost the same:
① Doubt phase: after a few days of gains, no one believes it, and everyone says it’s just a rebound to dump shares.
② Recognition phase: a new high is set, analysts turn bullish, and retail investors half-believe, half-doubt as they buy in.
③ Excitement phase: prices keep surging, people in the group start posting profits, and you begin to fear missing out.
④ Euphoria phase: everyone in your social feed is discussing coins, taxi drivers are recommending coins, and leverage rates are soaring.
⑤ Denial phase: prices start to fall, and everyone says it’s a “healthy pullback, a buying opportunity.”
⑥ Panic phase: prices keep crashing, and cries of capitulation are everywhere — and the seeds of the next round are buried here.

$ETH The third dip below 2300—and all three times, it bounced back

The 24-hour low was 2294.26, on yesterday’s noon candle. Then 2299.59 at 4 a.m. and 2296.30 at 8 a.m. Three breaks below the level, and all three times it closed back above 2300. Now it’s at 2334.

Up 0.49% over 24 hours, with $6.9 billion in trading volume. Looks calm on the surface.

But the positioning looks ugly: the long/short ratio is 3.42, with 77.4% of accounts positioned long. For ETH, that’s an extremely crowded trade.

My take: 2300 isn’t support—it’s a trigger zone built up by stop-loss orders. Those repeated wicks are someone scooping up those stops.

And it’s not just ETH that’s affected: L2 and ETH beta plays like OP, ARB, and ETHFI have higher beta. When ETH makes one wick, they make two.

What I’m doing: I’m not guessing which way 2300 will break. I’ll wait for ETH to hold above 2350 and funding rates to turn positive before making a call. If it dips below 2294 next time and can’t recover, that’s a real breakdown.

Risk: with 77% of accounts long, one genuine breakdown could trigger a cascade of liquidations.

The morning call that “the overnight triple cross turned into a chop center” and the midday call that “it moved a half-step lower but didn’t break out” both held up: starting from the 10:00 close at 79,818, all ten consecutive 1h closes from 10:00 to 19:00 stayed below 80,000. However, one part of the midday view needs to be toned down: “the good news did not warm up BTC, only smaller coins” — by the afternoon, even small coins cooled off. I’ve seen enough in the crypto world to know that most people who get liquidated and leave aren’t stupid, and they’re not brainless either. They’re just too impatient, too greedy, and too emotional, grinding themselves down to death.

Retail investors usually die in three common ways:

A few easily overlooked details 👇

🔹 Timeline: The FOMC meets over two days, October 27–28; the rate decision is set for 2:00 p.m. ET on October 28 (2:00 a.m. Beijing time on October 29), followed by a press conference by Chair Kevin Warsh
🔹 Rate status: The federal funds target range remains 3.75%–4.00%; after a 25 bps hike in September, the market’s mainstream expectation this time is to stay on hold
🔹 Probabilities: According to CME FedWatch, the probability of keeping rates unchanged is about 90%, while the probability of a hike is about 10%; but the probability of another 25 bps hike in December is priced above 70%
🔹 Inflation backdrop: September CPI was about 3.7% YoY, with core CPI around 2.6%, still clearly above the 2% target; elevated energy prices are the key issue at the center of officials’ debate over whether to keep tightening
🔹 For ordinary people: BTC/ETH volatility before the decision is mostly noise; what could really reshape risk appetite is the wording on inflation in the statement, and whether Warsh frames a “pause” as “another hike is still possible by year-end” — leveraged positions are most vulnerable to a sudden shift in expectations from dovish to hawkish

To put it simply: this is more like a preview of a hawkish hold, not an immediate rate-cut celebration. Long-term spot holding and riding out a contract position are two different things; if your position can’t handle the overnight volatility, reducing leverage first is more practical than trying to guess direction.

以太坊当前报价约2315美元，过去24小时下跌0.75%，价格在2300至2330美元区间内窄幅震荡。从近五个小时的K线数据来看，ETH多次测试2300美元支撑位，但均获得买盘支撑未能有效跌破。最新一根小时K线收于2327美元，显示出一定的反弹动能。

关键价位方面，短期支撑位集中在2300美元整数关口，该位置是近几个小时的低点区域，也是心理支撑位。上方阻力位位于2330美元附近，对应布林带上轨位置。若能有效突破2330美元，则有望向2350美元发起挑战；反之，若跌破2300美元，则可能下探至2280美元甚至更低。

二、技术指标解读

从小时级别技术指标来看，以太坊当前呈现出短期反弹、中期偏弱的格局。

均线系统方面，7周期均线约2315美元，25周期均线约2317美元，99周期均线约2346美元。当前价格刚刚突破7均线，正在向25均线发起挑战，但仍远低于99均线，表明短期动能有所恢复，但中期趋势仍偏弱。

MACD指标显示，快线数值为负2.04，慢线为负3.50，柱状图为正1.46。MACD虽然仍处于零轴下方，但柱状图连续放大，快线正在快速向慢线靠拢，即将形成金叉，这是一个积极的看涨信号。

RSI指标方面，6周期RSI为69.5，12周期RSI为56.7，24周期RSI为50.4。短期RSI已经接近超买区域，显示短期买盘动能强劲，但尚未进入极端超买状态。

KDJ指标表现强势，K值66.6，D值52.2，J值95.4。J线已经接近超买区域，三线同步向上发散，显示短期多头占据优势。

威廉指标从负49快速回升至负18.7，脱离超卖区域，进一步确认短期反弹趋势。

综合因子统计显示，15个技术因子中有10个看涨、4个看跌、1个中性，看涨因子占比达到66.7%。复合指标发出看涨信号，数值为0.79，历史胜率约70.8%，表明短期反弹概率较大。但需要注意的是，价格仍远低于99均线，中期下行趋势尚未扭转。

三、市场情绪分析

从基本面来看，以太坊当前面临一定的抛压。现货ETF持续流出，10月26日单日净流出8860万美元，同时有45240枚ETH被转移至机构托管账户，显示机构资金在持续撤离。以太坊基金会卖出2785枚ETH，ICO参与者也向交易所转移了数千枚ETH，增加了市场流通供应。

不过，企业层面的买盘提供了一定缓冲。Bitmine公司累计增持10452枚ETH，价值约2400万美元，吸收了部分交易所卖盘。链上数据显示，OBV指标虽然仍为负值，但正在逐步回升，表明买盘正在逐步接手卖盘。

市场情绪方面，投资者对以太坊的态度较为谨慎。ETF持续流出和美联储决议的不确定性可能继续压制反弹空间。但若美联储释放鸽派信号，加上机构资金重新进场，以太坊有望迎来一波修复性行情。

综合来看，以太坊短期技术面出现反弹信号，但基本面压力依然存在。建议投资者密切关注2300美元支撑位的稳固性，以及ETF资金流向和美联储决议。在方向明确之前，建议轻仓操作，控制风险。若能有效突破2350美元并站稳，则中期趋势可能转向看涨。

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Are the Fuel Costs of a Blockchain?
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay gas fees to transfer funds and to mint an NFT—but who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transferring funds, trading, running
a contract) consumes computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (gas unit price).

【Why it’s related to the coin price】A hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → skyrocketing gas fees. That’s why seasoned users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

translatedData.content:
The figure worth discussing in the Dutch central bank’s first-ever statistics on crypto holdings is not the “1.4%” itself, but what it measures. According to PANews, as of the end of June 2026, Dutch households held approximately €3.2 billion in crypto assets through domestic crypto-asset service providers, equivalent to 1.4% of their total investments in stocks, funds, and bonds. The statistics exclude crypto assets held by Dutch residents with overseas providers or in self-custody wallets, as well as indirect crypto investments.

My observation: 1.4% is more like a lower bound than a complete picture of Dutch households’ crypto exposure. The reason lies in the scope of the statistics: they cover only holdings “through domestic Dutch service providers,” leaving assets held on overseas platforms or in personal wallets entirely out of view. The more authoritative official data is, the easier it is to mistake it for a complete picture; here, however, there is a structural gap. Without subsequent estimates covering overseas platforms and self-custody, any conclusion that “Dutch households have very little crypto exposure” lacks a complete basis.

The composition is also worth unpacking. Of the €3.2 billion, around €1.5 billion was in Bitcoin, close to half; approximately €300 million was in Ethereum; and stablecoins accounted for less than 1%. This suggests that the visible holdings lean toward core assets held for the long term, rather than stablecoins used for everyday payments or as a temporary store of funds. The sub-1% stablecoin share may also reflect the scope of the statistics: stablecoins used to facilitate trading may not remain in accounts with domestic service providers for long. The summary does not provide this information, so it cannot be confirmed.

For readers, the takeaway is this: when you see an official figure for a share, first ask who is covered by its scope. The test is specific: will the Dutch central bank later add estimates for overseas platforms and self-custody, and will stablecoin statistics be adjusted to account for changes in payment use? If the share rises significantly once the scope is expanded, that would indicate the current figure is systematically understated; if the change is limited, the lower-bound assessment still holds.

#BTC #ETH #Stablecoins

Source:
PANews (originally published 10-27 at 19:45 Beijing time)
https://www.panewslab.com/zh/articles/01a17d2e-44e4-72c9-ad08-512dacf9a0da

content:
荷兰央行首次公布的加密持有统计，真正值得讨论的不是“1.4%”这个数字本身，而是它测的是什么。据PANews报道，截至2026年6月底，荷兰家庭通过本国加密资产服务商持有约32亿欧元加密资产，相当于其股票、基金和债券投资总额的1.4%。该统计不包括荷兰居民存放于境外服务商或自托管钱包的加密资产，也不包括间接加密投资。

我的观察是：1.4%更像一条下限，而非荷兰家庭加密敞口的全貌。原因在统计边界——只统计“通过荷兰本地服务商”的持有，意味着把资产放在境外平台或自己钱包里的部分完全落在视野之外。官方数据越权威，越容易被误读成全景；而这里恰恰是结构性缺口。若后续没有对境外与自托管的补充估算，任何“荷兰家庭加密配置很低”的结论都缺乏完整依据。

结构信息同样值得拆。32亿欧元中比特币约15亿欧元，接近一半；以太坊约3亿欧元；稳定币占比不足1%。据此推断，这批可见持仓更偏向长期持有的核心资产，而非把稳定币当作日常支付或停留工具。稳定币不足1%也可能与统计口径有关——用于交易周转的稳定币未必长期停留在本地服务商账户里，这一点本次摘要未提供，无法确认。

对读者的含义是：看到官方占比数据时，先问口径覆盖了谁。验证条件很具体——荷兰央行后续是否补充境外平台与自托管估算，以及稳定币统计是否随支付场景变化而调整。若补充口径后占比明显上移，说明当前数字被系统性低估；若变化有限，则下限判断依然成立。

SK Hynix is about to release its Q3 earnings, and even bigger news is that it plans to unveil a new shareholder return program at the same time. The market is watching demand for AI memory (HBM), next year’s performance, and whether the company will pay a sizable special dividend. Samsung and Kioxia are also set to report soon, so the memory giants are getting ready to show their strength. In short: The AI memory business is booming, and SK Hynix wants to raise money while also rewarding shareholders. Investors are watching the drama unfold—and wondering whether this move could affect memory prices.

Why does this news matter?
SK Hynix has been a standout performer in the AI memory supercycle. Its sudden announcement of a shareholder return program is about more than just reporting earnings. It reflects a tug-of-war in the capital markets: With memory prices high, the company wants to retain capital through dividends, but paying out too much could lead the market to think it plans to cut production. Put simply, this is about how companies balance short-term profits with long-term growth as demand for AI computing continues to surge.

Market impact
This news is unlikely to benefit BTC and ETH in the short term, but it will intensify debate over whether memory prices are justified. Crypto investors usually focus on global liquidity, and moves by memory stocks may indirectly reflect how major institutions prefer to allocate their capital. For example, if SK Hynix does pay a sizable special dividend, it could draw some funds flowing out of crypto into traditional markets, though the amount is unlikely to be large.

Trading perspective
SK Hynix’s shareholder return program is more like icing on the cake; strong expectations for AI memory demand are already in place. If memory prices continue to rise, the program won’t change the industry’s trajectory, but it could make investors more inclined to hold memory stocks rather than cryptocurrencies. This means that, at this stage, crypto markets may face competition from a broader range of investment options.

NIP Group是那种"别人不敢买的时候我敢买"的类型。他们现在买矿机，说明要么是觉得$79,929.37的比特币价格被低估了，要么是算力博弈中要占个先机。为什么重要？因为这意味着比特币的挖矿成本曲线在继续变陡峭。简单说：挖矿越来越贵了。

对市场的影响
短期内，NIP Group这种机构行为会提振矿机厂商订单，但BTC价格直接带动效应有限。因为市场现在更关心美联储的嘴炮和CPI数据。长期看，如果NIP Group这种资金持续流入挖矿，会推高比特币的护城河。历史参考的话，2021年那个疯狂时期，大量科技基金也买了矿机。

A calm mind can heal countless afflictions. I entered the scene in 2016 and grew from 800 yuan to 48 million. It wasn’t talent that got me there, but a half-invested strategy that many people laughed at as “too timid.” Being steady isn’t being cowardly—it’s the only skill ordinary people need to survive in the market. 

Divide your capital into five parts and invest only one part at a time. Set a 10% stop-loss: one losing trade costs just 2% of your total capital, and even five losses in a row would cost only 10%. When you’re right, aim for at least 10% profit. Slow is fast; compounding depends on avoiding big losses.

Follow the trend; don’t try to guess the bottom. Bounces during a downtrend are traps, while pullbacks in an uptrend are opportunities. The trend is always smarter than you—don’t fight it.
$BTR
Stay away from coins that have already surged. Coins that rise too sharply in the short term often run out of steam. When prices move sideways at a high level, it’s often a setup to trap buyers. Don’t bet on it continuing to rise; just focus on not doing anything reckless.

MACD is your radar. A golden cross below the zero line followed by a break above it is a buy signal; a death cross above the zero line is a signal to reduce your position. Learn to use this and you’ll avoid a lot of pitfalls.

Never average down on a losing position. Buying more as the price falls only sinks you deeper. Add to profitable positions only; cut losing trades promptly.

Volume and price tell the truth. A high-volume breakout from a low level is often a signal that a rally is taking off. If volume surges at a high but the price can’t rise, it’s time to prepare to exit. Candlesticks can be drawn; trading volume is much harder to fake. $MAGMA

Trade only in uptrends. An upward-sloping 3-day moving average signals a short-term opportunity; an upward-sloping 30-day average indicates a strengthening medium-term trend; an upward-sloping 84-day average often signals the main bull run; and an upward-sloping 120-day average points to a long-term bull market. Don’t fantasize about a reversal during a downtrend.

Review every trade: Why did I buy? Why did I sell? Does my rationale still hold? Does the weekly chart support it? Turn every decision from luck into skill.

Going from 800 to 48 million was the result of a set of rules I could stick to. Stay steady, get the timing right, and trade with discipline—that’s the right path for ordinary people. $ZKP

translatedData.content:
After getting liquidated, watching my account get cut in half, and losing so much I questioned my whole life, here are the only 9 things I’ve learned on my way to becoming an A8. Beginners, take a look and save yourself some detours.
#ETH 
I’m not afraid to admit it: I’ve been liquidated, watched my account get cut in half, and lost so much that I’d stare blankly at my account in the middle of the night, wondering if I was even cut out for this.

After slowly climbing back, I realized something: if you’ve been trading crypto for over a year and your account still hasn’t passed 800,000, what you lack most isn’t capital—it’s understanding.

First, don’t rush when you’re starting with little money. What’s most dangerous with a small account? Going all in at the top and using leverage. You can miss the move and lose your whole account.

Second, you can’t make money beyond your understanding. Blaming the market after a loss gets you nowhere. The truth is, you didn’t understand what was happening. If you don’t understand it, practice with a small position. Don’t force it.

Third, most news is there to get you to buy in so others can cash out. When a real move starts, nobody believes it. When the group chats start frantically calling for trades, the move is often nearly over.

Fourth, generally trade less around holidays. This is especially true with high leverage—that’s when you’re most likely to get stopped out for no apparent reason.

Fifth, don’t expect to capture the whole move with a medium- or long-term trade. Sell a little when it rises, buy a little when it falls, and build your position gradually. Don’t rush.

Sixth, a slow bleed wears you down the most, while a sharp drop can sometimes present an opportunity. The rebound after a panic sell-off is often more reliable.

Seventh, admit when you’re wrong. As long as your capital is still there, you have another chance. Holding on stubbornly only turns a small loss into a big one.

Eighth, keep your charts simple. Familiar candlesticks and one or two indicators are enough. The more you look at, the more confused you get—you can’t think straight.

Ninth, master one strategy. Don’t learn one thing today and another tomorrow. People who make money consistently end up relying on one method they know inside out, and using it over and over.
Understanding and discipline really matter far more than short-term profits.
#币圈暴富 
#CryptoBeginners

content:
爆仓、腰斩、亏到怀疑人生，到现在的A8只记住这9句话，小白们看过来，让你少走弯路
#ETH 
说出来不怕你笑，我爆过仓、腰斩过、亏到半夜盯着账户发呆，怀疑自己是不是根本不适合做这行。

后来一步步爬回来，我发现一个问题：你做币超过一年，账户还没突破80万，最缺的不是本金，是认知。

第一，钱少的时候别急。 小本金最怕什么？满仓追高、加杠杆，行情没抓住，账户先没了。

第二，赚不到认知之外的钱。 亏了怪市场没意义，本质是你没看懂。看不懂就小仓位练，别硬上。

第三，大部分消息都是来收割你的。 真正行情启动的时候没人信，群里开始疯狂喊单的时候，往往已经快到头了。

第四，节假日前后基本少操作。 尤其高杠杆，那段时间最容易莫名其妙被扫。

第五，中长线别想着一次吃完。 涨了卖一点，跌了接一点，慢慢滚，别急。

第六，阴跌最磨人，急跌反而可能有肉。 恐慌砸盘之后的反弹，往往更靠谱。

第七，错了就认。 本金还在就有机会，死扛只会把小亏变成大亏。

第八，盯盘越简单越好。 熟悉的K线，一两个指标，够了。看越多越乱，脑子都不清楚。

第九，一招练到极致。 别今天学这个明天学那个，那些稳定赚钱的人，到最后靠的就是一套最熟的方法，反复用。
认知和纪律，真的比短期利润重要多了

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Staying Out Is a Position Too—and One the Pros Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have is that not holding a position means you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and market swings whittle away their capital.

In fact, staying out of the market is the only position with zero losses. If you can’t read the market, stay out,
When the bulls and bears are battling it out, staying out of the market—and staying out after a few losses in a row—the money you save in those moments
is more than most people make from their trades.

We’ve all heard the hunting analogy, but it’s true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. Keep your capital intact, and you’ll have bullets when opportunities arise. Hold on to your bullets.

一、以太坊市场分析：升级延迟叠加ETF持续流出，两千三百美元支撑面临考验

二〇二六年十月二十七日，以太坊现货价格报两千三百零六点六美元，过去二十四小时下跌百分之零点六六。价格在两千二百九十七美元至两千三百二十五美元之间波动，整体维持在两千三百美元关口附近窄幅整理，市场信心受到多重利空因素压制。

一、价格走势分析

从最近五根一小时K线观察，以太坊走势较为平淡。第一根K线开盘两千三百零五美元，盘中最高触及两千三百二十三美元，最低两千三百零一美元，收盘两千三百一十五美元，成交量八千三百五十五枚以太坊。随后两根K线实体明显缩小，成交量分别降至七千零九十枚和四千一百七十三枚，显示市场交投意愿不足。第四根K线放量反弹，成交量达到一万一千七百二十四枚以太坊，价格最高触及两千三百二十五美元，但收盘仅报两千三百一十六美元，上影线较长说明上方抛压沉重。最新一根K线开盘两千三百一十六点五美元，目前交投于两千三百二十一点附近。布林带显示上轨两千三百二十八美元、中轨两千三百一十六美元、下轨两千三百零五美元，带宽持续收窄，暗示变盘行情即将来临。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现明显的空头格局。当前价格低于七日均线两千三百一十四美元、二十五日均线两千三百一十八美元以及九十九日均线两千三百四十八美元，三条均线自上而下排列，对价格形成层层压制。MACD指标中DIF线为负二点八一，信号线为负三点七九，虽然柱状图已由负转正至零点九八，显示下跌动能有所减弱，但DIF和信号线均处于零轴下方，整体仍偏空运行。RSI六周期指标回升至六十一点零五，RSI十二周期为五十二点三七，短期动能有所恢复但力度有限。KDJ指标K值五十九点四上穿D值四十七点零四，J值达到八十四点一七，形成短期金叉，但考虑到整体趋势偏弱，这一信号的可靠性需要成交量配合确认。超级趋势指标维持在两千三百五十二美元高位不变，价格距离该指标仍有较大差距，说明中期下行趋势尚未扭转。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的核心压力来自两方面。首先是机构资金的持续撤离，现货以太坊ETF单日净流出八千八百六十万美元，单周累计流出超过八万五千八百枚以太坊，这种持续性的赎回行为对现货市场构成了直接的卖压。其次是基金会和早期投资者的减持，以太坊基金会近期抛售两千七百八十五枚以太坊，ICO参与者和部分基金也在清仓持仓，进一步加大了市场供给。利好方面，以太坊生态的代币化资产赛道仍在发展，币安代币化股票市值已超过Ondo，显示以太坊生态在RWA领域仍有竞争力。但Glamsterdam升级因安全审计问题被推迟，短期内削弱了市场对技术升级的预期。两千三百美元是当前的关键心理支撑位，若跌破可能下探至两千两百美元区域。投资者需密切关注ETF资金流向变化以及升级时间表的更新。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your reasoning), what went right or wrong (in terms of execution),
and what you’ll do differently next time (a specific action). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be amazed to discover: your losses
Your trade history is full of the same mistakes repeating—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or never letting winning trades run.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just check your account balance—go through your trading records.
